Title: Generally Available: Azure Bastion Developer now in 36 public regions

Body.Content:
Previously available in 6 limited regions, Azure Bastion Developer has now expanded to a total of 36 public regions with support for more regions coming soon. Bastion Developer provides secure-by-default RDP/SSH connectivity to VMs without the need for a public IP—all for free. This offering is ideal for Dev/Test users who want to securely connect to their VMs but don't need additional Bastion features or host scaling. With Bastion Developer, you can connect to one Azure VM at a time directly through the virtual machine connect blade.  

Learn more.
